O-001.name: Customer
O-001.description: A customer space that isolates material and decisions.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this customer in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this customer in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this customer, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: Customer contacts and material boundaries; retention remains to be agreed.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this customer, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this customer, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

contact.name: Contact
contact.meaning: A lead-confirmed customer contact for clarifying feedback; the email domain grants no permission.

retention.name: Material retention agreement
retention.meaning: The lead agrees material retention with the customer; retain an explicit open note until agreed.
retention.example: To be agreed; no retention period is assumed.
retention.required_when: When the customer or studio needs a material-retention agreement.

O-002.name: Delivery item
O-002.description: The agreed deliverable, milestones and scope.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this delivery item in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this delivery item in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this delivery item, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: The agreement covers the main-page text and layout; another export layout needs a new assessment.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this delivery item, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this delivery item, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

scope.name: Agreed scope
scope.meaning: The lead maintains the agreed boundary so designers can identify additional scope.
scope.example: Main-page text and layout; no additional export size or layout.

milestone.name: Committed milestone
milestone.meaning: A customer-and-lead commitment; a request or AI draft cannot replace it.

customer.name: Customer ID
customer.meaning: The owning customer selected at creation, used to link delivery items and isolate feedback.

O-003.name: Customer feedback
O-003.description: Original words, source, attachments and current handling status.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this customer feedback in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this customer feedback in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this customer feedback, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: The customer requests another export layout before Friday delivery; retain the words separately from the assessment.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this customer feedback, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this customer feedback, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

customer.name: Customer ID
customer.meaning: The owning customer selected at creation, used to link delivery items and isolate feedback.

delivery.name: Delivery item ID
delivery.meaning: The agreed item addressed by the feedback, checked by the designer; request information if unresolved.

original_words.name: Customer’s words
original_words.meaning: Words supplied by the customer, retained with their source rather than overwritten by an assessment.
original_words.example: Could we add another export layout before Friday?

attachments.name: Original attachments
attachments.meaning: Material attached by the customer or designer; retain unreadable references and ask for a replacement.
attachments.example: The synthetic feedback brief attached to Q-002.

source.name: Feedback source
source.meaning: The designer confirms the channel so people can return to the original email, chat or review note.

expected_change.name: Desired change
expected_change.meaning: The change requested by the customer and clarified by the designer, separate from the quote and agreed scope.
expected_change.example: Add another export size and layout; the second reference attachment and cost evidence remain to be supplied.

expected_date.name: Requested date
expected_date.meaning: A date requested by the customer for assessment, not a lead commitment.

needs_lead.name: Needs lead confirmation
needs_lead.meaning: The designer uses scope, cost and milestone impact to route the request under BR-002/003.
needs_lead.example: Yes: another export layout exceeds the agreement.

return_reason.name: Return reason
return_reason.meaning: On return, the lead identifies missing information so the designer can continue in the same feedback.
return_reason.example: Please supply the second reference attachment and cost estimate.
return_reason.required_when: When the lead returns the feedback for more information.

draft.name: Needs information
draft.meaning: The delivery item or desired change is missing; continue in the same feedback.

review.name: Awaiting lead
review.meaning: The designer submitted an assessment and awaits the authorized lead’s decision.

confirmed.name: Confirmed
confirmed.meaning: The relevant business decision is saved; delivery and AI drafts do not imply it.

deferred.name: Deferred
deferred.meaning: The lead saved a deferral with a follow-up condition and no new date.

O-004.name: Impact assessment
O-004.description: The designer’s evidence about scope, cost and schedule impact.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this impact assessment in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this impact assessment in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.
title.example: Scope and milestone impact of another export layout

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this impact assessment, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: Another export size needs design, layout checks and customer confirmation and cannot be assumed to be a small change without schedule impact.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this impact assessment, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this impact assessment, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

scope_change.name: Scope change
scope_change.meaning: The designer compares the agreement and request, showing both additions and unchanged scope to the lead.
scope_change.example: Add another export layout; the agreed main-page text and layout remain unchanged.

schedule_impact.name: Milestone impact
schedule_impact.meaning: The designer explains milestone impact and gaps so the lead can decide.
schedule_impact.example: Assess after receiving the attachment and cost evidence; the original Friday commitment is not yet confirmed for the addition.

missing.name: Missing evidence
missing.meaning: Name material missing from this assessment rather than treating unknown effort as fact.
missing.example: The second reference attachment and cost estimate for the additional layout.

O-005.name: Lead decision
O-005.description: An explicit acceptance, decline, return or deferral.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this lead decision in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this lead decision in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.
title.example: Decision to defer the additional export layout

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this lead decision, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: Wait for the second reference attachment and cost estimate, then ask the lead to review effort and scheduling.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this lead decision, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this lead decision, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

outcome.name: Decision
outcome.meaning: The lead explicitly confirms, declines, returns or defers; it becomes a decision only after saving.

agreed_date.name: Agreed date
agreed_date.meaning: A new date agreed with the customer when a lead confirms an addition; do not invent one for deferral.
agreed_date.example: Set after confirmation; this deferral has no new date.
agreed_date.required_when: When the lead confirms added scope with a new milestone commitment.

reason.name: Decision basis
reason.meaning: The lead explains the business basis so the customer and designer can understand and continue.
reason.example: Reference material and cost evidence are incomplete, so effort and schedule impact cannot yet be assessed.

follow_up.name: Follow-up condition
follow_up.meaning: For a return or deferral, explain when to reassess without creating a separate request.
follow_up.example: Reassess in FB-042 after the attachment and cost evidence are supplied.
follow_up.required_when: When the decision returns or defers the request.

confirmed.name: Confirmed
confirmed.meaning: The lead saved an acceptance and its conditions.

declined.name: Declined
declined.meaning: The lead saved a decline and its basis.

returned.name: Returned for information
returned.meaning: The lead identified a gap; the designer continues in the original feedback.

deferred.name: Deferred
deferred.meaning: Reassess when a stated condition is met, without inventing a commitment date.

O-006.name: Notification delivery
O-006.description: A delivery outcome for a decision and a specific recipient.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this notification delivery in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this notification delivery in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this notification delivery, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: The decision is saved, but the mail service returned no definite receipt; review it before retrying.

owner.name: Responsible member
owner.meaning: The member responsible for following up this notification delivery, explicitly assigned within the project without granting other customer access.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this notification delivery, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.meaning: The specific person to inform; track that recipient’s delivery outcome separately.
recipient.example: The authorized customer representative for C-014

channel.name: Channel
channel.meaning: The delivery channel, used by the lead to assess a failure and choose recovery.

delivery_key.name: Delivery deduplication key
delivery_key.meaning: A system-generated identity for a decision and recipient, used for review and deduplication rather than manual entry.

attempts.name: Retry count
attempts.meaning: The system records actual attempts for review; this does not define an agreed retry limit.

failure.name: Failure explanation
failure.meaning: Record the specific failure or unknown receipt to guide recovery without cancelling the decision.
failure.example: The receipt is unclear; check the same delivery record first.
failure.required_when: When delivery fails or the receipt cannot be confirmed.

pending.name: Pending
pending.meaning: The decision is saved, but no definite delivery result is available.

delivered.name: Delivered
delivered.meaning: A definite receipt is available for this recipient; do not resend the same record.

failed.name: Failed, needs review
failed.meaning: Review the failure or unknown receipt, retaining the decision and delivery identity.

O-007.name: Project member
O-007.description: Membership, project scope and explicitly assigned roles.

id.name: Record ID
id.meaning: Identifies this project member in discussion, records and relationships; renaming does not change the reference.

title.name: Name
title.meaning: A member-confirmed name or short summary for this project member in lists; it does not replace the stable reference.

description.name: Description
description.meaning: Optional business context and open points for this project member, maintained by the responsible member for continued collaboration.
description.example: A synthetic studio member with lead duties only in the explicitly granted project.

created_at.name: Created at
created_at.meaning: The first saved time of this project member, recorded by the system for historical ordering rather than re-entered by the user.

project.name: Project ID
project.meaning: The project explicitly granted by an administrator; studio membership does not grant other projects.

role.name: Assigned role
role.meaning: An explicitly assigned business role used by access policies, never guessed by AI.

granted_by.name: Granted by
granted_by.meaning: Who granted membership, used to review its source rather than identify the member or business decision maker.

REL-005.description: Link stable identities; review deleted or invalid references explicitly rather than silently inferring ownership.

REL-006.name: Produces delivery records
REL-006.description: Link stable identities; review deleted or invalid references explicitly rather than silently inferring ownership.

REL-007.name: Maintains assessment evidence
REL-007.description: Link stable identities; review deleted or invalid references explicitly rather than silently inferring ownership.

REL-008.description: Link stable identities; review deleted or invalid references explicitly rather than silently inferring ownership.
